written_by: paper evaluator (overseer session), from the accepted population surface and the thirty frozen questions only, before phase two
surface: 27 record types: ENTITY 20, EVENT 2, RELATION 5; subject-bearing Claim, Observation, CountObservation; subtypes on the surface: CountObservation of Observation, ResearchSource of Source, RockSample of Sample, GeologicalEvent of Event, ContributionRelation and StudyRelation of ResearchRelation, CreditRelation of ContributionRelation
method: one set per question id; a set lists the surface types whose rows the question asks for and every surface subtype of each listed type (type_set_closure); no catalogue type the question does not ask for (ResearchSource, which carries the reference list, only where a study, repository or publication record is asked); Sample, Source and ResearchRelation are never listed as such, their concrete subtypes are; GeologicalEvent listed where the question is about earthquakes as occurrences, because on this surface GeologicalEvent wears Quantified and carries one quantity; Evidence listed where an evidence relation is asked
